source: Read from the installed Claude Code 2.1.330 engine (Bun binary, strings) on 2026-11-23: the dialog registry (`Df`), each dialog's `ds({kind, result})` definition, the notification sender, and the session-status writer. Not a live capture; see planning/CLAUDE_REQUESTS_V2.md.

notification.sender: Each registry entry with a `notification` raises the Notification hook (hooks run before any terminal channel, regardless of preferredNotifChannel) once the dialog has been shown and the person has not touched the terminal for 6000 ms. A missing `type` defaults to `permission_prompt`.

fields.waitingFor: registry waitingFor of the top dialog, else 'permission prompt'; 'input needed' for an MCP elicitation; 'sandbox request'; 'worker request'; 'dialog open' for a local JSX command

sessionStatusFile.timing: Written as the top dialog changes, with no idle delay (statusUpdatedAt stamps it).

dialogs.hooks: none (no PermissionRequest; PreToolUse/tool.call see the tool call only)
dialogs.needs: choose: allow or deny the computer-use action

dialogs.hooks: PreToolUse, PermissionRequest (tool.call and classic.PermissionRequest in a mod)
dialogs.result: options yes-accept-edits | yes-auto-clear-context | yes-bypass-permissions (clear context), yes-accept-edits-keep-context | yes-resume-auto-mode, yes-default-keep-context, ultraplan, no (+ feedback)

notification.text: Claude Code needs your approval for the plan

dialogs.raisedBy: MCP elicitation/create after Elicitation hooks returned nothing
dialogs.hooks: Elicitation (before the dialog), ElicitationResult + Notification elicitation_response (after a dialog answer)

notification.text: An MCP server needs your input

dialogs.raisedBy: an API refusal with a fallback model offer
dialogs.hooks: none for the choice (PreModelSwitch fires only if the person picks the fallback model)
dialogs.needs: choose: retry on fallback model or edit prompt

dialogs.raisedBy: Fable plan/seat usage exhausted, usage credits available
dialogs.payload: overagesEnabled, modelName?, leftOutOf plan|seat, endedOn?, balanceCents?, currency?
dialogs.needs: choose: continue on usage credits or switch models

notification.text: A sandboxed command needs network access
Claude wants to use your browser
Claude Code wants to enter plan mode
A message from another session needs your approval
Auto mode has a classifier billing notice to acknowledge
Auto mode can't check actions in this session and needs your choice
Managed settings need your review before they apply

notDialogs.mcp_oauth_sign_in: Model-mediated: an MCP server that needs auth exposes mcp__<server>__authenticate (and complete_authentication for remote sessions). Its tool result carries {status, authUrl, message}; the callback is a loopback listener on the Mac. In a local session a pasted URL cannot finish the sign-in; /mcp (a local JSX command, waitingFor 'dialog open') is the terminal path. Headless (-p) sessions do not offer the authenticate tool.
notDialogs.workspace_trust: Shown before the session starts; no hook, mod or session status exists yet.
